arxiv-2011-14527.title: Characteristic cycles associated to holonomic 𝒟 \mathscr{D} -modules
arxiv-2011-14527.creator: Lei Wu
arxiv-2011-14527.description:
A 2020 arXiv research paper by Lei Wu. We study relative and logarithmic characteristic cycles associated to holonomic 𝒟 \mathscr{D} -modules. As applications, we obtain: (1) an alternative proof of Ginsburg’s log characteristic cycle formula for lattices of regular holonomic 𝒟 \mathscr{D} -modules following ideas of Sabbah and Briancon-Maisonobe-Merle, and (2) the constructibility of the log de Rham complexes for lattices of holonomic 𝒟 \mathscr{D} -modules, which is a natural generalization of Kashiwara’s constructibility theorem. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2107-07497.creator: Puneet Mangla, Shivam Chandhok, Vineeth N Balasubramanian, Fahad Shahbaz Khan
arxiv-2107-07497.description: Abstract Recent progress towards designing models that can generalize to unseen domains (i.e domain generalization) or unseen classes (i.e zero-shot learning) has embarked interest towards building models that can tackle both domain-shift and semantic shift simultaneously (i.e zero-shot domain generalization).

arxiv-2411-02003.title: Against Multifaceted Graph Heterogeneity via Asymmetric Federated Prompt Learning
arxiv-2411-02003.creator: Zhuoning Guo, Ruiqian Han, Hao Liu
arxiv-2411-02003.description: Abstract . Federated Graph Learning (FGL) aims to collaboratively and privately optimize graph models on divergent data for different tasks. A critical challenge in FGL is to enable effective yet efficient federated optimization against multifaceted graph heterogeneity to enhance mutual performance. However, existing FGL works primarily address graph data heterogeneity and perform incapable of graph task heterogeneity.

arxiv-2412-13543.title: Query-centric Audio-Visual Cognition Network for Moment Retrieval, Segmentation and Step-Captioning
arxiv-2412-13543.creator: Yunbin Tu, Liang Li, Li Su, Qingming Huang
arxiv-2412-13543.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yunbin Tu, Liang Li, Li Su, Qingming Huang. Video has emerged as a favored multimedia format on the internet. To better gain video contents, a new topic HIREST is presented, including video retrieval, moment retrieval, moment segmentation, and step-captioning. The pioneering work chooses the pre-trained CLIP-based model for video retrieval, and leverages it as a feature extractor for other three challenging tasks solved in a multi-task learning paradigm.

arxiv-2503-05730.title: Robust Optimization with Diffusion Models for Green Security
arxiv-2503-05730.creator: Lingkai Kong, Haichuan Wang, Yuqi Pan, Cheol Woo Kim, Mingxiao Song, Alayna Nguyen, Tonghan Wang, Haifeng Xu, Milind Tambe
arxiv-2503-05730.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lingkai Kong, Haichuan Wang, Yuqi Pan, Cheol Woo Kim, Mingxiao Song, Alayna Nguyen, Tonghan Wang, Haifeng Xu, Milind Tambe. In green security, defenders must forecast adversarial behavior—such as poaching, illegal logging, and illegal fishing—to plan effective patrols. These behaviors are often highly uncertain and complex. Prior work has leveraged game theory to design robust patrol strategies to handle uncertainty, but existing adversarial behavior models primarily rely on Gaussian processes or linear models, which lack the expressiveness needed to capture intricate behavioral patterns.

pmc-12513837.title: Targeting histone H2B acetylated enhanceosomes via p300/CBP degradation in prostate cancer
pmc-12513837.creator: Jie Luo, Zhixiang Chen, Yuanyuan Qiao, Jean Ching-Yi Tien, Eleanor Young, Rahul Mannan, Somnath Mahapatra, Rupam Bhattacharyya, Lanbo Xiao, Tongchen He, Sanjana Eyunni, Yuping Zhang, Yang Zheng, Fengyun Su, Xuhong Cao, Rui Wang, Yunhui Cheng, Rithvik Seri, James George, Miriam Shahine, Stephanie J.
pmc-12513837.description: Prostate cancer is driven by oncogenic transcription factor enhanceosomes comprising chromatin and epigenetic regulators. The lysine acetyltransferases p300 and CREB-binding protein (CBP) are key cofactors that activate enhancers through histone acetylation. Here we identify p300/CBP-mediated multisite histone H2B N-terminal acetylation (H2BNTac) as a defining feature of oncogenic enhanceosomes in androgen receptor (AR)-positive prostate cancer.

pmc-12516324.creator: Jordy Dekker, Wendy Lam, Herma C van der Linde, Floris Ophorst, Charlotte de Konink, Rachel Schot, Gert-Jan Kremers, Leslie E Sanderson, Woutje M Berdowski, Geeske M van Woerden, Grazia M S Mancini, Tjakko J van Ham
pmc-12516324.description: Biallelic variants in thioredoxin-related transmembrane 2 protein (TMX2) can cause a malformation of brain cortical development characterized by microcephaly, polymicrogyria and pachygyria by an unknown mechanism. To investigate and visualize how TMX2 loss disrupts brain development in vivo, we generated zebrafish deficient for TMX2 ortholog tmx2b, which during the first two developmental days showed normal brain developmental hallmarks.

pmc-12981548.title: Scalability Metrics and Effort Requirements for a Long-Acting Injectable Antiretroviral Treatment Program
pmc-12981548.creator: Joshua P Havens, Jennifer O’Neill, Maureen Kubat, Shawnalyn W Sunagawa, Jennifer M Davis, Nada Fadul, Joshua Lechner, Sara H Bares
pmc-12981548.description: Implementation of a long-acting injectable antiretroviral treatment program requires substantial multidisciplinary effort, particularly for program coordination, coverage/billing, and patient support/retention. As our program scaled to 113 patients over 2.5 years, a total of 2.25 full-time equivalents were required. Despite operational demands, clinical outcomes were favorable, supporting real-world feasibility and scalability.
